title: Barry says the secrecy sucks

tellings.quote: "Holy cow. Can you believe this is being kept secret?" And he goes, "I it sucks. I know."

plain: Between 1987 and 1989, at a secret site in the Nevada desert he calls S4, a man named Bob Lazar says he turned to a coworker named Barry Castilio and asked, "Can you believe this is being kept secret?" According to Lazar, Castilio answered, "it sucks. I know." Lazar tells it firsthand, as a sign that even the people inside the program were uneasy about hiding what they worked on.
